hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/findings_guard.py"; elif ls "${REVIEW_FINDINGS_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/review-findings}"/*.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Refused by the review-findings plugin: python3 is not installed, and the folder ~/.claude/review-findings still holds pending review findings, so they cannot be checked. Developer: install Python 3, or delete that folder in a terminal (rm -r ~/.claude/review-findings).' >&2; exit 2; fi
